answer: Reputation decay: a score falls 8 points per idle epoch after 2 idle epochs, from 100; below 60, rewards and voting weight are lost. A fake farm's forge cannot mint reputation: only verified work restores 6 points per epoch, capped at 100, so idle clones decay while honest agents climb. Scores are public in an atlas, and a cipher binds each score to its identity, blocking transfers. Plagiarism drops the score to 20 and freezes it 6 epochs. 1,000 clones need 3,000 units of maintenance per epoch to stay above 60; a missed cycle costs 8,000 points across the farm.
